popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Book II's Catalogue of Ships and the Aetolian contingent — Thoas son of Andraemon leads forty ships from Pleuron and Calydon among the Achaeans at Troy.

popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Apollodorus lists Thoas among the Achaean leaders — the Aetolian king who fights at Troy, distinct from the Taurian and Lemnian namesakes.

popCulture.title: Thoas (king of Aetolia)
popCulture.description: Aetolian king who led his people to Troy — Homer's Thoas of Pleuron, not the Taurian sacrifice-king of Euripides.
